Synopsis:
    Nasdaq 100 and S&P 500 futures edged higher ahead of August Nonfarm Payrolls, with equity sentiment supported by Fed Governor Waller's signal that he would back holding rates steady if inflation continues to ease. Markets repriced a rate hike probability lower (63% → ~50%). Payrolls are expected to rebound to +56K after July's surprise -23K print. Individual stock movers include LULU (-17.67%) on guidance cut and ADBE (-3.18%) on CEO transition. Seasonal headwinds (September historically weak, particularly in the second half) and upcoming CPI/PPI prints next week are key near-term watchpoints.
